== Research Notes ==
=== Father identification ===

[[Glasgow-653|Joseph Glasgow]] is confidently inferred to be this person’s father, assessed 92%. Rose/Ralston fits Rosannah’s existing Joseph-family placement, 1807 birth, Faris p. 34 and the two-Ralston-sister group. The abbreviated name, unnamed Ralston husband and sparse individual biography leave a little more identity uncertainty than Rebecca’s explicit Joseph/Nancy account. <ref name="Miami1919">John C. Hover et al., eds., ''Memoirs of the Miami Valley'' (Robert O. Law Company, 1919–1920), “S. S. Glasgow,” printed pp. 257–258; [https://digital.cincinnatilibrary.org/iiif/2/p16998coll15:18001/full/full/0/default.jpg original p. 257] and [https://digital.cincinnatilibrary.org/iiif/2/p16998coll15:18002/full/full/0/default.jpg original p. 258], Cincinnati & Hamilton County Public Library Digital Library; images inspected 22 October 2026. Published family biography, not a civil or parish register.</ref>

The memoir never names Joseph: its sibling group is linked to [[Glasgow-1625|Robert Anderson]], whose 1880 county biography names Joseph and Nancy. The memoir’s ancestral migration story is inconsistent with Joseph’s Virginia birth, and Eliza/Breckenridge appears to be a Campbell half-sister. These problems qualify the whole-pair inference; no mother or vital fact is changed. The 1880 statement is used from its published citation and held biographical account, not a newly inspected image.


=== Earlier father assessment, 22 October 2026 — superseded ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-653]] is assessed at 88% (probable). Faris’s 1990 Glasgow Family genealogy supplies the Joseph/Nancy family framework; Rosannah’s 1807 placement has a specific Faris p.34 citation despite sparse prose. Joseph’s reported 1820 Ohio death is compatible with the birth, but no original relationship passage is transcribed.

Selected father-profile identity and paternal relationship; maternal identity is separate.

Next useful test: Read Faris’s Joseph child list and trace this child’s original marriage/probate evidence.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-647 A source for this information is needed.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
